reviews.text: They explained it to me very carefully!

I always rely on them when my dog ​​unexpectedly steals food.

They are always quick, caring, and helpful, which gives me great peace of mind.

I can make reservations via LINE, and I receive notifications when my appointment time is approaching, so I don't worry about waiting.
I am always grateful for your kind and thorough examinations.

Thank you as always!

The reception staff, nurses, and doctors are all so polite and reassuring!

I'm also happy that I can make appointments via LINE and there's no waiting time.

The head doctor has a wonderful personality; he's kind, gentle, and easy to talk to.

I'm so glad this hospital is nearby.

If you're undecided about which animal hospital to choose, I highly recommend this one!

We are always grateful for the care we receive from the head veterinarian.

Even when we bring our pets in for minor issues, they treat us kindly and provide a reassuring environment for us as pet owners.

I am grateful for the thorough and careful examinations. I have several pets here, and the doctor always carefully checks the condition of each and every one of them. My pet has high liver enzyme levels and has been taking Ursodeoxycholic acid for a year, but the doctor carefully reviewed the past test results and explained the future treatment plan in detail. Also, when another pet injured its leg, the doctor carefully observed how it was walking and checked its condition by palpation, showing great attention to detail. Regarding vaccinations, the doctor prioritizes the pet's health and checks the test results before administering them, demonstrating excellent consideration for safety. I am so glad to have found such a trustworthy doctor and staff. I will continue to rely on their services in the future.

I visited this clinic on a friend's recommendation.

The doctor was kind, explained things clearly, and I felt I could trust them. They were gentle with the animals, and the examination was calm and peaceful.

I got the impression that they take their time with each patient, and I think it's a very thorough examination.

It's a bit of a distance from my home, but there's parking available, making it easy to get to.

I would like to use this clinic as my regular vet in the future.

I came to the clinic for a second opinion.

The phone service was excellent, which convinced me to come in.

The doctor in charge looked young, but he answered all my questions very thoroughly,
which gave me a great sense of reassurance! Wonderful!

Incidentally, I consulted ChatGPT about my dog's cough, sneezing, breathing, and teeth, and this hospital was recommended.
I thought there would be a long wait, but I was able to register via LINE, and the process until the examination was quite smooth, so it wasn't stressful at all.
The diagnosis also cleared up many of my questions, leaving me feeling very relieved. The doctor in charge was able to examine my timid Chihuahua's mouth properly and said that my dog ​​was well-behaved.

Even my usual vet couldn't examine him, so I think this doctor is very skilled!

I'm always grateful for your help. The doctor and all the staff are very kind.
My dog ​​had surgery for bladder stones here. Even though they're busy, they treat both pets and their owners with care.
You can make an appointment online, so you can check the schedule for appointments, which is convenient.

All my cats are being looked after by this doctor. The doctor who first saw them is the one in charge, but even if I suddenly go on a day when another doctor is there, there is a smooth handover so I don't feel anxious. They also explain in detail the parts of the test results that we don't understand, so I feel at ease. My one cat is not nervous at all and is in a relaxed mode. He sometimes does rude things like putting his leg on the doctor's arm, but he forgives me...
The teachers and staff are always very kind and helpful, which is reassuring.

I received care for my beloved cat's diabetes and kidney disease for about three years.

They always listened to my concerns with genuine care, and I relied on them like a "comrade-in-arms."

Thanks to the warm support of Dr. Inoue, the nurses, and all the staff, my cat passed away peacefully at home the other day. Dr. Inoue's cheerful personality helped me through many difficult times. I think my cat didn't like him, but I loved him.

I am deeply grateful for their support until the very end. This is a trustworthy hospital.
The staff were kind and polite.

The doctors are all very attentive and listen carefully.
However, the waiting times are incredibly long...
Two hours is the norm.
Also, the fees are quite high. I suppose it's unavoidable considering the location, but it's just... really expensive.
The teacher always listens carefully and is very kind, so my child doesn't mind coming.

I was a patient there for several years. The head veterinarian, the other doctors, and the nurses were all incredibly kind and supportive, and it's a wonderful hospital that stayed by my beloved dog's side until the very end. The hospital staff were well-coordinated, and even when my usual vet was on leave, I could rest assured that my dog ​​would be seen there. I was so relieved and grateful to have this hospital!
The examination was very thorough, and the doctor worked very hard to treat me.

I use this as my cat's regular doctor, and I have nothing but great things to say. 

I don't usually have a specific doctor in mind, so I speak to a variety of doctors, but they are all very considerate and take my concerns seriously. 

It's popular, so you may have to wait a little, but it's great that you can make an appointment from home via LINE.

I came in for a checkup today for otitis externa.
I always feel at ease thanks to the thorough examination and easy-to-understand explanations I receive.
The staff's responses are also smooth and pleasant.
I have stayed overnight with you many times, feeling at ease.
The explanations and examinations are thorough and reassuring
He spoke in a gentle and easy-to-understand manner, and I felt reassured by his accurate response.

My dog ​​is a 9-year-old Toy Poodle.

We regularly take him to this clinic for treatment of hypothyroidism, rabies vaccinations, and other vaccinations. The doctor and staff are very thorough during consultations and provide accurate advice, which I greatly appreciate. Previously, there were long waiting times, but now we can book appointments via LINE, which is a huge help.

They always explain things to me in detail, which is very helpful. My dog ​​hates hospitals, but they are very kind to even dogs who don't like hospitals. I'm also happy that I can now make appointments via LINE, which has shortened the waiting time a little!
The price is a little on the high side, but they treat pets with great care and attention.
I go there for exotic pet treatment. They are very kind, and I feel at ease because they not only provide specialized treatment for exotic pets but also offer lots of advice.

The doctor examined me and explained things clearly and carefully, which made me feel at ease.
He also demonstrated how to administer the eye drops so that I wouldn't be scared, which alleviated my anxiety.
I'm glad that the doctor was so kind.

The LINE registration system is practically non-functional. I registered 30 minutes before my appointment time, but after 3 hours I hadn't been called, so I went in person. It turns out they prioritize those who come in person.

The LINE registration system was completely pointless.

Please be aware of this if you plan to visit.

My Shiba Inu is always a handful because he gets so unruly every time we bring him in, but the head veterinarian is always so kind and thorough, and I'm incredibly grateful. The other veterinarians and staff are also cheerful and kind, so I feel at ease bringing him in. As he gets older, I'm sure we'll be relying on them even more, so I hope they'll continue to take care of us in the future. Even if you book an appointment via LINE, there's still quite a wait, but I guess that's unavoidable since it's a popular hospital.
I am always grateful for the kind and attentive care I receive from the head doctor. I look forward to continuing to rely on your services in the future.
The doctor and staff are all very polite and kind. I was especially impressed by the head doctor; he was easy to talk to and very considerate of my needs.
As many others have also written, the wait is unbelievably long. They only came to pick me up at the designated time, but it took 3 hours and there was no apology whatsoever.

The teachers are very kind, but I don't understand why I have to wait over 30 minutes even after registering on LINE and being shown as second in line.
I waited a long time to be called on LINE, but when I went to see them after not being called, I was told that my turn had passed.
I would like the connection between LINE's registration system and practical work to be improved.

All the doctors are kind and provide thorough examinations.
The facilities are well-equipped, and most tests can be done here.
However, it can feel a little expensive.
They don't push unnecessary tests and explain everything properly beforehand.
However, because there are multiple doctors, I sometimes feel that information isn't communicated effectively.
You can check the work schedule on their website, so it might be a good idea to check before you go.
I'm satisfied with the consultations, but the long waiting times are a major drawback.
Even with an appointment, it doesn't change.
They've introduced a LINE call system, but even if you arrive at the called time, it can still take more than 30 minutes before you're seen.
I wish they would make it more efficient.
Even when it's not busy, you should allow at least an hour.
Weekends are often crowded, and it can take two hours, so I recommend going on a weekday if possible.
It's very convenient that they accept PayPay and other electronic money for payment.
The doctors and staff are all kind and polite. The clinic is also clean and tidy. You can also make appointments via LINE, so you can get an efficient consultation.

Every December, I take my dog ​​for a one-day check-up.

After this, I feel like the year has safely come to an end, and I can welcome the new year with peace of mind.

Thank you for explaining everything so clearly.
The thorough examination and explanation gave me a sense of reassurance.

This is a hospital I've been going to for the past few years.

The veterinarians, nurses, and reception staff are all very helpful and always explain things in detail when I have questions.

It's a hospital I would like to continue using in the future.

I've been to many animal hospitals in the past, but today I once again felt that this is the best. The doctor is thorough and honest, and I think he keeps the fees low. I've moved and it's a little farther away, but I've decided to make this my regular doctor.
From Mignon

I have my two cats examined by the head veterinarian. He explains everything very carefully during the examination, which puts me at ease as a pet owner. I also use their cat health checkup service, and they've been able to identify and address any concerns early on. Being able to schedule appointments via LINE from home is also very convenient. I'm truly grateful to have such a trustworthy animal hospital nearby.

The doctors are always very kind and thorough with their examinations. Their explanations are easy to understand, which is very helpful. The nurses are also all very kind, so I feel at ease when I visit the clinic. (^^)

I always have my dog ​​examined by the head veterinarian. My dog ​​turned 8, so I had a health checkup done. The doctor explained everything very carefully and examined every part of the dog, which gave me peace of mind. …

Thank you so much for your continued support.

You always look after our pet in emergencies and provide detailed and helpful …

Thank you for always taking care of me! 
They are very kind and I can always leave them in their care with peace of mind!

They examine our pets kindly and thoroughly. We go to the clinic every week, and all of our pets love going. I think it's because all the staff are so warm, kind, and treat our pets with such care. You can also make appointments via LINE, and it's helpful that you can get a rough idea of ​​the waiting time.

I always take my dog ​​in for checkups and treatment. The doctor is efficient and I feel confident leaving him in their care. Previously, the waiting times were long, but now they offer LINE reservations.
